pages.title: Evaluation & Submission
pages.content:
# Evaluation & Submission

This page covers how to format a submission and how entries are scored. For the
task, dataset and timeline, see the Overview tab.

## Building predictions

Produce one detection file per evaluation frame, named after that frame's id.
The frame ids you must predict are listed in the starting kit
(`validation_frames.txt` for Development, `test_frames.txt` for Final). Each
line is one detection with nine fields:

```
# cls cx cy cz dx dy dz yaw score
1 12.34 -3.21 0.05 4.10 1.92 1.55 1.5708 0.97
```

* `cls` ∈ {1=Vehicle, 2=Bike, 3=Pedestrian}
* `cx cy cz`: box centre in metres, "top" ego frame
* `dx dy dz`: length, width, height in metres
* `yaw`: heading (rotation about +z) in radians
* `score`: confidence in [0, 1] (used for ranking detections)

Zip the per-frame files at the root of the archive and upload on the Submit tab.
The starting kit's `SUBMISSION_FORMAT.md` is the authoritative spec, with a
sample submission and a format-checker. Run the checker before you upload.

## Evaluation

We follow the official Mixed Signals / OpenCOOD evaluation protocol exactly,
so leaderboard numbers are directly comparable to the dataset paper.

### Metric

* Matching: Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) rotated-box IoU between predicted and
  ground-truth boxes (the z/height dimension is not used for matching, in line
  with the dataset benchmark).
* Average Precision (AP): VOC-2010 "all-points" interpolation, the area
  under the precision-recall curve (not the 11-point variant).
* Per class: AP is computed independently for vehicle, bike and
  pedestrian at IoU thresholds 0.3, 0.5 and 0.7.
* Matching rule: within each frame, detections are ranked by descending
  confidence and greedily matched to ground-truth boxes. Each ground-truth box
  can be matched at most once. Unmatched detections (or matches below the IoU
  threshold) are false positives.
* Evaluation range: boxes whose centre falls outside `x, y ∈ [-51.2, 51.2] m`
  are excluded from both predictions and ground truth before scoring.

### Ranking by mAP

The leaderboard is ranked by the headline mAP, the mean of the three per-class
operating points reported in the paper:

```
mAP = mean( Vehicle AP@0.5 , Bike AP@0.5 , Pedestrian AP@0.3 )
```

(Pedestrians are scored at the looser 0.3 IoU because the boxes are small.) The
leaderboard also reports Vehicle and Bike AP at IoU 0.5/0.7 and Pedestrian AP at
IoU 0.3/0.5, matching the published tables, but only mAP decides the ranking.
Ties on mAP are broken by the leaderboard columns left to right (starting with
Vehicle AP@0.5), then by submission time, so earlier submissions rank higher.

### Scoring program

The scoring program is open and downloadable from the Submit / Files
area. It depends only on `numpy` and implements the BEV IoU and VOC AP from
scratch, so you can run it locally against your own validation labels to
reproduce leaderboard scores exactly.
pages.content_zh:
# 评估与提交

本页介绍如何格式化提交内容以及条目的评分方式。有关任务、数据集和时间表，请参阅"概览"选项卡。

## 构建预测

为每个评估帧生成一个检测文件，文件名以该帧的id命名。您需要预测的帧id列在起始工具包中（开发集使用`validation_frames.txt`，最终测试使用`test_frames.txt`）。每一行是一个检测，包含九个字段：

```
# cls cx cy cz dx dy dz yaw score
1 12.34 -3.21 0.05 4.10 1.92 1.55 1.5708 0.97
```

* `cls` ∈ {1=车辆, 2=自行车, 3=行人}
* `cx cy cz`：边界框中心，单位为米，"顶部"自车坐标系
* `dx dy dz`：长、宽、高，单位为米
* `yaw`：航向角（绕+z轴旋转），单位为弧度
* `score`：置信度 ∈ [0, 1]（用于排序检测）

将各帧文件压缩到存档根目录并在"提交"选项卡中上传。起始工具包中的`SUBMISSION_FORMAT.md`是权威规范，包含示例提交和格式检查器。上传前运行检查器。

## 评估

我们完全遵循官方Mixed Signals / OpenCOOD评估协议，因此排行榜数据可直接与数据集论文进行比较。

### 指标

* 匹配：预测框与真实框之间的鸟瞰图（BEV）旋转框交并比（IoU）（不使用z/高度维度用于匹配，与数据集基准一致）。
* 平均精度（AP）：VOC-2010"全点"插值法，精确率-召回率曲线下的面积（非11点变体）。
* 各类别：AP在IoU阈值0.3、0.5和0.7处分别针对车辆、自行车和行人独立计算。
* 匹配规则：在每一帧内，检测按置信度降序排列，并贪心地与真实框匹配。每个真实框最多只能匹配一次。不匹配的检测（或低于IoU阈值的匹配）为假正例。
* 评估范围：中心落在`x, y ∈ [-51.2, 51.2] m`范围外的边界框在评分前从预测和真实数据中排除。

### 按mAP排名

排行榜按标题mAP排名，即论文中报告的三个各类别操作点的平均值：

```
mAP = mean( 车辆 AP@0.5 , 自行车 AP@0.5 , 行人 AP@0.3 )
```

（行人使用较宽松的0.3 IoU评分，因为其边界框较小。）排行榜还报告车辆和自行车在IoU 0.5/0.7处的AP以及行人在IoU 0.3/0.5处的AP，与已发表的表格一致，但仅mAP决定排名。mAP的平局按排行榜列从左到右打破（从车辆AP@0.5开始），再按提交时间打破，因此较早的提交排名较高。

### 评分程序

评分程序是开源的，可从"提交/文件"区域下载。它仅依赖`numpy`，从零开始实现BEV IoU和VOC AP，因此您可以在本地针对您自己的验证标签运行它，以精确再现排行榜分数。

By registering for and participating in the Mixed Signals: V2X Collaborative 3D
Object Detection Challenge (the "Competition"), you agree to the following terms.

A. The Competition uses the Mixed Signals dataset, released under

   dataset is not redistributed through this platform. You must obtain it from

C. You must cite the Mixed Signals paper (see the Overview tab) in any
   publication or report that uses the dataset or your Competition results.

## 2. Submissions

A. Submissions consist of prediction files only. Do not attempt to upload or
   execute code that probes, reverse-engineers, or exfiltrates the hidden test

D. Per-phase submission limits are enforced by the platform and may be adjusted

## 3. Eligibility, teams and fair play

A. Teams may have one or more members. All members must be registered and a

B. Organizers and individuals with access to the hidden test annotations are not

C. The use of any data, pretrained models, or external resources must comply

   used, organizers may require disclosure for verification.

## 4. Prizes

C. Prizes may be subject to applicable laws, taxes, and export restrictions.

B. The organizers may publish participant usernames/team names, scores, and
   aggregate statistics.

C. The organizers' decisions on scoring, ranking, eligibility, and rule
   interpretation are final.

## 6. Disclaimer

The Competition, dataset, and scoring software are provided "as is" without
warranty of any kind. The organizers are not liable for any damages arising from
participation. The organizers reserve the right to modify these terms, the
schedule, or the evaluation at any time, with reasonable notice to participants
via the competition pages.

## 7. Contact

For questions, contact the organizers at the email listed on the competition
homepage.

数据由车载移动激光扫描系统采集，覆盖厦门市多类典型城市街区，累计道路长度约60 km。数据包含墙面、窗户、门、屋顶、广告牌、空调外机、雨棚和阳台等细粒度建筑立面要素标注，并提供语义级与实例级标签。

17265.description_zh:
This competition focuses on fine-grained understanding of urban-level building facade components, utilizing the City-Fac dataset.

The data is collected by vehicle-mounted mobile laser scanning systems, covering multiple types of typical urban street blocks in Xiamen, with a cumulative road length of approximately 60 km. The dataset includes fine-grained building facade element annotations such as walls, windows, doors, roofs, billboards, air conditioning units, canopies, and balconies, with both semantic-level and instance-level labels provided.

Participants need to identify independent building facade component instances in the test point cloud and output the corresponding semantic categories and instance numbers.

The competition adopts a result submission mode. Participants complete model training and inference locally and only submit prediction results to Codabench, where the platform automatically scores using hidden instance labels.

pages.title: 比赛说明
pages.content:
# **建筑物立面点云语义/实例分割**

## **Overview**

本赛道采用 City-Facade 城市建筑立面点云数据集，开展建筑立面点云语义分割与实例分割。

参赛者需要为测试集中的每个点预测语义类别，并进一步区分同一语义类别下不同建筑立面构件的实例编号。

City-Facade 数据由车载移动激光扫描系统采集，覆盖厦门市 6 类典型城市街区场景，累计道路长度约 60 km，包含约 2 亿个带标注点。

语义类别如下：

| **编号** | **英文类别**              | **中文类别** |
| -------- | ------------------------- | ------------ |
| 0        | Background / Unclassified | 背景或未分类 |
| 1        | Wall                      | 墙面         |
| 2        | Window                    | 窗户         |
| 3        | Door                      | 门           |
| 4        | Roof                      | 屋顶         |
| 5        | Advertisement             | 广告牌       |
| 6        | Air Conditioner           | 空调外机     |
| 7        | Rain Shed                 | 雨棚         |
| 8        | Balcony                   | 阳台         |

参赛流程：

1. 在训练数据集上开发三维点云语义分割与实例分割模型；
2. 使用训练完成的模型预测测试数据；
3. 为每个测试点生成语义标签和实例标签；
4. 按指定目录结构压缩预测结果；
5. 将结果上传至 Codabench；
6. 平台自动评测并更新排行榜。

数据集项目地址：

```text
https://github.com/Ting-Devin-Han/City-Facade
```

## **Evaluation**

主排名指标为综合得分：

```text
Score = 0.5 × mIoU + 0.5 × AP50
```

其中：

- mIoU 用于评价语义分割精度；
- AP50 用于评价实例分割精度。

辅助指标包括：

- mIoU
- OA
- 各类别 IoU
- AP
- AP25
- AP50

所有指标均为越高越好。

每支队伍每日最多提交 5 次。

若综合得分相同，建议依次按照 AP50、mIoU、AP25 和提交时间确定排名。

## **Submission Format**

参赛者须为测试集中的每个点提供语义标签和实例标签，并提交一个 ZIP 压缩包。

压缩包根目录必须包含`predictions/`文件夹：

```text
submission.zip
└── predictions/
    ├── CAR/
    │   ├── CAR-30-003_000000.txt
    │   ├── CAR-30-003_000001.txt
    │   └── ...
    ├── JMC/
    ├── SGS/
    ├── XHR/
    └── YWR/
```

目录名称和预测文件名称必须与测试数据保持一致。例如：

```text
test/JMC/JMC-1-013_000000.txt
predictions/JMC/JMC-1-013_000000.txt
```

每个预测 `.txt` 文件为 `N x 7` 数组，字段顺序固定为：

```text
X Y Z intensity instance_id semantic_label instance_score
```

其中：

- `N` 为点云点数；
- `X Y Z` 为三维坐标；
- `intensity` 为激光强度；
- `instance_id` 为预测实例编号；
- `semantic_label` 为预测语义类别；
- `instance_score` 为预测实例置信度

字段索引从 `0` 开始时：

```text
X=0, Y=1, Z=2, intensity=3, instance_id=4, semantic_label=5, instance_score=6
```

提交文件必须满足：

1. 每个测试 `.txt` 文件都必须有对应预测文件；
2. 预测文件的相对路径和文件名必须与测试集一致；
3. 每个预测文件的点数必须与对应测试文件完全一致；
4. 点顺序必须与测试文件完全一致；
5. `X Y Z intensity` 四列应保持与测试文件一致；
6. `semantic_label` 必须为整数，取值范围为 `0` 到 `8`；
7. `instance_id` 必须为非负整数；
8. `instance_score` 必须是 `[0,1]` 范围内的有限数值，不允许使用 `NaN` 或正负无穷。
9. 对于语义类别 `1` 到 `8` 的前景构件，不同实例应使用不同的实例编号；
10. 对于类别 `0` 的背景或未分类点，`instance_id` 可设为 `0`；
11. ZIP 根目录必须包含 `predictions/` 文件夹，不要额外嵌套一层目录。

## **Citation**

使用 City-Facade 数据集开展研究或发表成果时，请引用：

```bibtex
@article{chen2026cityfacade,
  title={City-Facade: A city-level large-scale point cloud building facade dataset for semantic \& instance segmentation},
  author={Chen, Yiping and Li, Jonathan and Han, Ting and Feng, Huifang and Chen, Jun and Wang, Cheng},
  journal={ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing},
  volume={232},
  pages={675--688},
  year={2026},
  doi={10.1016/j.isprsjprs.2026.01.003}
}
```
pages.content_zh:
# **Building Facade Point Cloud Semantic/Instance Segmentation**

## **Overview**

This track uses the City-Facade dataset to conduct semantic segmentation and instance segmentation of building facade point clouds.

Participants need to predict semantic categories for each point in the test set and further distinguish instance numbers of different building facade components within the same semantic category.

The City-Facade dataset is collected by vehicle-mounted mobile laser scanning systems, covering 6 typical urban street scene categories in Xiamen City, with a total road length of approximately 60 km and containing approximately 200 million annotated points.

Semantic categories are as follows:

| **ID** | **English Category**      | **Chinese Category** |
| ------ | ------------------------- | -------------------- |
| 0      | Background / Unclassified | Background/Unclassified |
| 1      | Wall                      | Wall                 |
| 2      | Window                    | Window               |
| 3      | Door                      | Door                 |
| 4      | Roof                      | Roof                 |
| 5      | Advertisement             | Advertisement Board  |
| 6      | Air Conditioner           | Air Conditioner Unit |
| 7      | Rain Shed                 | Rain Shed            |
| 8      | Balcony                   | Balcony              |

Competition workflow:

1. Develop 3D point cloud semantic and instance segmentation models on the training dataset;
2. Use the trained model to predict test data;
3. Generate semantic labels and instance labels for each test point;
4. Compress prediction results according to the specified directory structure;
5. Upload results to Codabench;
6. The platform automatically evaluates and updates the leaderboard.

Dataset project address:

```text
https://github.com/gorgeouseping/City-Facade
```

## **Evaluation**

The main ranking metric is the comprehensive score:

```text
Score = 0.5 × mIoU + 0.5 × AP50
```

Where:

- mIoU is used to evaluate semantic segmentation accuracy;
- AP50 is used to evaluate instance segmentation accuracy.

Auxiliary metrics include:

- mIoU
- OA
- IoU for each category
- AP
- AP25
- AP50

All metrics are higher the better.

Each team can submit a maximum of 5 times per day.

If the comprehensive score is the same, it is recommended to determine rankings in order by AP50, mIoU, AP25, and submission time.

## **Submission Format**

Participants must provide semantic labels and instance labels for each point in the test set and submit a ZIP compressed package.

```text
submission.zip
└── predictions/
    ├── CAR/
    │   ├── CAR-30-003_000000.txt
    │   ├── CAR-30-003_000001.txt
    │   └── ...
    ├── JMC/
    ├── SGS/
    └── ...
```

Directory names and prediction file names must be consistent with the test data.

Each TXT file contains 6 fields:

```text
X Y Z intensity semantic_label instance_id
```

Array dimensions are:

```text
N × 6
```

Where:

- `N` is the number of points in the point cloud;
- `X Y Z` are 3D coordinates;
- `intensity` is laser intensity;
- `semantic_label` is the predicted semantic category;
- `instance_id` is the predicted instance number.

Submitted files must satisfy:

1. The number and order of points are completely consistent with the original test files;
2. The 3D coordinates and intensity fields must not be modified;
3. Semantic category ID range is 0-8;
4. Instance IDs must be non-negative integers;
5. Different instances use different instance IDs;
6. Prediction file directories and file names must be consistent with the test set;
7. The ZIP root directory must contain a `predictions` folder.

## **Citation**

When using the City-Facade dataset, please cite:

```bibtex
@article{chen2026cityfacade,
  title={City-Facade: A city-level large-scale building facade point cloud dataset for semantic and instance segmentation},
  author={Chen, Yiping and Li, Jonathan and Han, Ting and Feng, Huifang and Chen, Jun and Wang, Cheng},
  journal={ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing},
  volume={232},
  pages={675--688},
  year={2026},
  doi={10.1016/j.isprsjprs.2026.01.003}
}
```

17680.title: Who is Behind the Avatar?  Verifying Teleoperator Identity in Reenacted Avatar Videos
17680.description: Welcome to the first International Competition on Verifying Teleoperator Identity in Reenacted Avatar Videos. The competition will be in conjunction with [ACCV2026](https://https://accv2026.org/])
17680.description_zh: 欢迎来到首届"重演化身视频中远程操作者身份验证"国际竞赛。本竞赛将与[ACCV2026](https://https://accv2026.org/)联合举办。

pages.title: Overview
pages.content:
Welcome to the first International Competition on **Teleoperator Identity Verification in Reenacted Avatar Videos (Who Is Behind the Avatar?)— WBA2026 @ ACCV, Osaka, Japan**. ## Motivation Photorealistic avatars are increasingly used in telepresence, mixed reality, gaming, virtual environments, and AI-mediated video communication. In these settings, the visible face may be synthetic or may differ entirely from the person controlling it. Consequently, conventional face-recognition methods may not be sufficient to verify the identity of the underlying user. The **WBA** competition investigates whether behavioral information preserved in avatar videos can be used to authenticate the human teleoperator independently of the avatar’s visual appearance. Unlike conventional DeepFake-detection challenges, **WBA** does not ask participants to determine whether a video is real or synthetic. Avatar-generated videos are treated as legitimate communication media. The objective is instead to verify **operator authenticity**: whether an avatar is controlled by the authorized person. ## Challenge Task
**WBA** is a **cross-avatar teleoperator verification challenge**. For each verification trial, participants are provided with: 1.A gallery avatar video driven by a known teleoperator 2. A probe avatar video driven by an unknown teleoperator. Participants must determine whether the two avatar videos are driven by: * **Same teleoperator**, representing a genuine trial * **Different teleoperators**, representing an impostor trial The gallery and probe videos may represent the same person through different avatar identities. Therefore, systems should focus on teleoperator-specific behavioral information rather than the visible appearance of the avatar. Potential behavioral cues include: * facial-motion dynamics * head movement and pose * expression timing * gaze behavior * speech-related facial movement * temporal motion patterns * other person-specific behavioral characteristics Participants may develop systems using RGB video, facial landmarks, head-pose features, expression dynamics, temporal motion descriptors, video embeddings, or other suitable representations. ## Dataset The source driving videos were collected in Japan during controlled dyadic online first-meeting conversations. The selected sequences are taken from the self-introduction portion of the conversations and include both speaking and listening segments. The original recordings were captured under controlled frontal-camera and lighting conditions. However, the original human videos are retained by the organizers and are not released to challenge participants. Instead, the motion and expression information from the original recordings are transferred to photorealistic avatar templates through a face-reenactment pipeline. The avatar appearances are selected from the publicly available **NVFAIR** dataset. This design reduces the direct exposure of the original participants’ visual identities while preserving motion and behavioral information relevant to teleoperator verification.
pages.content_zh: 欢迎来到首届**重演头像视频中的远程操作者身份验证国际竞赛——WBA 2026**。 ## 动机 超逼真头像越来越多地被应用于远程呈现、混合现实、游戏、虚拟环境和人工智能中介的视频通信。在这些应用中，可见的面孔可能是合成的，或者可能与控制它的人完全不同。因此，传统的面部识别方法可能不足以验证底层用户的身份。 **谁在头像后面？(WBA)** 挑战赛调查了头像视频中保留的行为信息是否可以用于独立于头像视觉外观的人类远程操作者身份认证。 与传统的深伪检测挑战不同，WBA不要求参与者判断视频是否真实或合成。头像生成的视频被视为合法的通信媒介。目标是验证**操作者的真实性**：头像是否由授权人员控制。 ## 挑战任务 WBA 2026是一项**跨头像远程操作者验证挑战**。 对于每次验证试验，参与者获得： 1. 由已知远程操作者驱动的图库头像视频；以及 2. 由未知远程操作者驱动的探针头像视频。 参与者必须确定这两个头像视频是否由以下任一情况驱动： * **相同的远程操作者**，代表真实试验；或 * **不同的远程操作者**，代表冒充试验。 图库和探针视频可能通过不同的头像身份代表同一个人。因此，系统应专注于远程操作者特定的行为信息，而不是头像的可见外观。 潜在的行为线索包括： * 面部运动动态 * 头部运动和姿态 * 表情时序 * 注视行为 * 与语音相关的面部运动 * 时间运动模式 * 其他人员特定的行为特征 参与者可以使用RGB视频、面部特征点、头部姿态特征、表情动态、时间运动描述符、视频嵌入或其他合适的表示方法开发系统。 ## 数据集 源驱动视频是在日本进行的受控二人组在线首次会面对话期间收集的。所选序列取自对话的自我介绍部分，包括说话和聆听片段。 原始录制是在受控的正面摄像头和照明条件下捕获的。但是，原始人类视频由组织者保留，不会向挑战参与者发布。 相反，来自原始录制的运动和表情信息通过人脸重演管道转移到超逼真头像模板。头像外观选自公开可用的 **NVFAIR** 数据集，而重演视频使用 **GAGAvatar** 生成。 这种设计减少了原始参与者视觉身份的直接暴露，同时保留了与远程操作者验证相关的运动和行为信息。 所发布的数据集中不包含音频，评估期间也不使用音频。

pages.title: Participation
pages.content: ### How to participate? Please register using your institutional email. Registrations with gmail.com or qq.com email addresses will not be approved. As well, the Team Leader must sign the license aggreement. If you are student, your supervisor must sign. ### How to get the dataset? Participants are required to sign the dataset license agreement and send the scanned PDF to alsherfawi@yy.d3c.osaka-u.ac.jp cc: allam@yy.d3c.osaka-u.ac.jp. You can download the agreement from [here](http://www.am.sanken.osaka-u.ac.jp/BiometricDB/dataset/Competition/WBA2026/WBA_ACCV_2026%20Competition_License%20Agreement.pdf). After the organizers verify the signed agreement they will send a link to download the data. Important: the dataset will be provided exclusively to registered participating teams and is strictly limited to use for the challenge.. If you have any questions or need further assistance, please don’t hesitate to reach out to alsherfawi@yy.d3c.osaka-u.ac.jp and cc: allam@yy.d3c.osaka-u.ac.jp ## Released Resources The organizers plan to provide: Data: * labeled training data (re-enacted videos and landmarks) * test data (for submission) * a sample submission [Starter kit](https://github.com/jasam-sheja/wba-starter) * evaluation code on validation subset * a submission-validation tool The baseline system is intended to support reproducibility, reduce the entry barrier, and encourage participants to investigate stronger temporal and behavioral representations. Follow the instructions in the [starter kit](https://github.com/jasam-sheja/wba-starter) to prepare the data for training. ## Data-Use Policy The challenge data may only be used in accordance with the official WBA 2026 participation rules and the provided license agreement associated with the source datasets and avatar-generation resources. Participants must not attempt to recover, identify, manually label, or disclose the identities of individuals represented in the hidden evaluation data. Access to hidden labels, avatar-template identities, or unauthorized annotations is prohibited.
pages.content_zh: 本竞赛面向所有人开放。 重要提示：请使用机构邮箱进行注册。使用gmail.com或qq.com邮箱的注册将不被批准。此外，团队负责人必须签署许可协议。如果您是学生，您的指导老师必须签署。 数据共享政策：在发布竞赛数据时，参与者需要同意仅将其用于"学术用途"。数据集将仅提供给已注册的参赛队伍，严格限制用于本竞赛。 如有任何问题或需要进一步协助，请随时联系ammar@yy.d3c.osaka-u.ac.jp，并抄送allam@yy.d3c.osaka-u.ac.jp 我们将提供 您可以使用以下代码库来提取数据：[初始工具包](https://github.com/jasam-sheja/OUMVLP-OF-challenge)。 ## 发布的资源 组织者计划提供： * 训练数据 * 测试数据访问说明 * 官方验证试验列表 * 基准嵌入和相似度系统 * 评估代码 * 样本提交 * 提交验证工具 * 竞赛规则和文档 基准系统旨在支持可重复性，降低参赛门槛，并鼓励参与者研究更强的时序和行为表示。 ## 数据使用政策 竞赛数据的使用必须符合官方WBA 2026参赛规则以及源数据集和虚拟人生成资源相关的许可证。 参与者不得试图恢复、识别、手动标记或泄露隐藏评估数据中所代表个人的身份。禁止访问隐藏标签、虚拟人模板身份或未授权的注释。 参赛队伍使用的任何外部数据集、预训练模型或其他资源必须在技术报告中披露，并须符合其适用的许可证。

pages.title: Submission
pages.content: ## Training and Test Protocol The training and test sets are disjoint with respect to both: * teleoperator identity; and * avatar appearance. No teleoperator appearing in the test set is included in the training set. Similarly, the avatar templates used for testing are not included in the training data. This protocol evaluates whether submitted systems can generalize to: * unseen teleoperators; * unseen avatar identities; * different speaking conditions; * variations in avatar geometry and motion response. The challenge is designed to discourage reliance on avatar appearance and encourage the development of representations that capture persistent teleoperator-specific behavioral characteristics. ## Submission Important: For a submission to be considered valid, all models used must be trained exclusively on the provided training data. Submissions must not rely on external datasets, external models, pretrained models trained on other datasets, or any similar external resources. . Participants are required to generate and submit an embedding for every test video. For each verification pair, the submitted gallery and probe embeddings are compared using one of the following measures: * cosine similarity or cosine distance; or * Euclidean distance. Participants specify the comparison method used by their system at submission time. ## Evaluation The official evaluation metrics is **Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve — AUC** EER is reported as an additional reference metric and is not used to determine the final leaderboard ranking. Performance is evaluated under three conditions: ### Speaking Condition Both the gallery and probe videos contain speaking sequences. ### Non-Speaking Condition Both the gallery and probe videos contain listening or non-speaking sequences. ### Cross-Condition One video contains a speaking sequence, while the other contains a non-speaking sequence. The final leaderboard score is calculated as the **average AUC across the three evaluation conditions**.
pages.content_zh:
## 训练和测试协议

训练集和测试集在以下两个方面是互不相交的：

* 遥操作员身份；以及
* 虚拟形象外观。

测试集中出现的任何遥操作员都不包含在训练集中。同样，用于测试的虚拟形象模板不包含在训练数据中。

该协议评估提交的系统是否能够泛化到：

* 未见过的遥操作员；
* 未见过的虚拟形象身份；
* 不同的说话条件；
* 虚拟形象几何形状和运动响应的变化。

该挑战旨在抑制对虚拟形象外观的依赖，并鼓励开发能够捕捉持久遥操作员特定行为特征的表示方法。

## 提交

参赛者需要为每个测试视频生成并提交一个嵌入向量。

对于每对验证样本，提交的库嵌入和探针嵌入使用以下度量之一进行比较：

* 余弦相似度或余弦距离；或
* 欧几里得距离。

参赛者在提交时指定其系统使用的比较方法。

Codabench评估程序从提交的嵌入向量计算验证得分和相应的性能指标。

## 评估

官方评估指标包括：

* **受试者工作特征曲线下面积 — AUC**
* **等错误率 — EER**

团队的排名仅根据 **AUC** 确定。

EER作为附加参考指标报告，不用于确定最终排行榜排名。

性能在三种条件下进行评估：

### 说话条件

库视频和探针视频都包含说话序列。

### 非说话条件

库视频和探针视频都包含聆听或非说话序列。

### 交叉条件

一个视频包含说话序列，另一个包含非说话序列。

最终排行榜得分计算为**三种评估条件下的平均AUC**。

pages.title: Overview
pages.content:
# LiDAR-Visual-Inertial SLAM

This is the independent LiDAR-visual-inertial track of the Multi-Sensor LiDAR SLAM Challenge 2026. Participants process the two released scenes locally and submit estimated trajectories only. Reliable ground truth and its timestamps remain private on Codabench.

Both `scene_0001` and `scene_0002` are required. Completion has no hard threshold; missing trajectory coverage reduces AUC recall and the final score.

The dataset was recorded with an Airy LiDAR and its built-in IMU plus the front-left and front-right Seeker fisheye cameras. The following images are route-shape references only and contain no ground truth.

![Scene 1 trajectory reference](images/scene_0001_trajectory_reference.png)

![Scene 2 trajectory reference](images/scene_0002_trajectory_reference.png)
pages.content_zh:
# LiDAR视觉惯性SLAM

这是多传感器LiDAR SLAM挑战赛2026的独立LiDAR视觉惯感融合赛道。参赛者本地处理两个发布场景并仅提交估计轨迹。可靠的地面真值及其时间戳在Codabench上保持私密。

两个场景`scene_0001`和`scene_0002`为必需。完成没有硬性阈值；轨迹覆盖不足会降低AUC召回率和最终分数。

该数据集由Airy LiDAR及其内置IMU加上前左和前右Seeker鱼眼相机采集。以下图像仅为路线形状参考，不包含地面真值。

![场景1轨迹参考](images/scene_0001_trajectory_reference.png)

![场景2轨迹参考](images/scene_0002_trajectory_reference.png)

pages.title: Submission
pages.content:
# Submission format

Upload a ZIP whose root contains `README.md` and `trajectories/scene_0001.txt` plus `trajectories/scene_0002.txt`. Each trajectory uses TUM rows:

```text
timestamp tx ty tz qx qy qz qw
```

Timestamps must be strictly increasing. Values must be finite and quaternions must be non-zero. There is no submission-count limit. Only the most recent valid submission is ranked.
pages.content_zh:
# 提交格式

上传一个ZIP文件，其根目录包含 `README.md` 和 `trajectories/scene_0001.txt` 以及 `trajectories/scene_0002.txt`。每个轨迹使用TUM格式：

```text
timestamp tx ty tz qx qy qz qw
```

时间戳必须严格递增。数值必须是有限的，四元数必须非零。提交次数无限制。仅最新的有效提交将参与排名。

pages.title: Evaluation
pages.content:
# Evaluation

Scoring uses EVO time synchronization and one no-scale SE(3) alignment per scene against the private reference trajectory. Completion has no hard threshold and is published; missing pose pairs reduce AUC recall. Evaluation timestamps and ground truth are not published.

ATE is EVO translational APE RMSE. AUC uses EVO one-frame translational RPE and the F1-AUC protocol. RTE is the RMSE of EVO translational RPE normalized at 1 m, 5 m, and 10 m. Aggregate and per-scene RTE@1m, RTE@5m, and RTE@10m are all published alongside the combined RTE. Gaps over 0.3 s are never crossed.

AUC and RTE use aligned world-frame positions with identity orientations, so a fixed participant body-axis convention does not affect translation scores. Every scene uses one scene-level SE(3) alignment.

The total score is `100 * (0.40 * AUC + 0.40 * exp(-ATE / tau_ate) + 0.20 * exp(-RTE / tau_rte))`. Reference result is the published reference: its aggregate ATE and RTE define `tau_ate` and `tau_rte` after the final scorer is frozen.

Results publish the total score, aggregate and per-scene AUC/ATE/combined RTE/RTE@1m/RTE@5m/RTE@10m, normalized score components, completion, and match counts. Per-timestamp errors, associations, alignment transforms, and ground truth remain private.

# 评估方法

AUC和RTE使用对齐的世界坐标系位置（姿态为恒等）计算，因此固定的参与者机体坐标系约定不会影响平移分数。每个场景使用一个场景级SE(3)对齐。

# LiDAR-Inertial SLAM

This is the independent LiDAR-inertial track of the Multi-Sensor LiDAR SLAM Challenge 2026. Participants process the two released scenes locally and submit estimated trajectories only. Reliable ground truth and its timestamps remain private on Codabench.

Both `scene_0001` and `scene_0002` are required. Completion has no hard threshold; missing trajectory coverage reduces AUC recall and the final score.

The dataset was recorded with an Airy LiDAR and its built-in IMU. The following images are route-shape references only and contain no ground truth.

pages.title: Submission
pages.content:
# Submission format

Upload a ZIP whose root contains `README.md` and `trajectories/scene_0001.txt` plus `trajectories/scene_0002.txt`. Each trajectory uses TUM rows:

```text
timestamp tx ty tz qx qy qz qw
```

Timestamps must be strictly increasing. Values must be finite and quaternions must be non-zero. There is no submission-count limit. Only the most recent valid submission is ranked.

```text

```

时间戳必须严格递增。数值必须是有限的，四元数必须非零。提交次数无限制。只有最新的有效提交才会被排名。
